scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @daydreaming/shared && npm run build --workspace @daydreaming/api && npm run build --workspace @daydreaming/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @daydreaming/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @daydreaming/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @daydreaming/web
scripts.format: prettier --write "apps/**/*.{ts,tsx,js,html,json}" "packages/**/*.{ts,tsx,js,json}" package.json tsconfig.base.json vitest.config.ts eslint.config.js .prettierrc.json ARQUITETURA.md PLANO_MIGRACAO.md MIGRACAO.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "apps/**/*.{ts,tsx,js,html,json}" "packages/**/*.{ts,tsx,js,json}" package.json tsconfig.base.json vitest.config.ts eslint.config.js .prettierrc.json ARQUITETURA.md PLANO_MIGRACAO.md MIGRACAO.md
